translations.en:
A cockatrice variant whose
whole body seems charged with
cold. Its poisonous gaze turns
those who meet it to stone, and
reports also describe poisonous
breath that causes disease.

A seasoned adventurer should
know well how to fight this
monster, but complacency
is a dangerous enemy.

translations.en:
Thought to be a young
dragon whose whole body is
coated in poisonous fluids.

It protects itself with
poison, which cannot
kill the creature itself.
Underestimate it as a mere
hatchling and it is liable
to call its companions,
leaving you surrounded
by monsters before you
realize what is happening.

translations.en:
Said to be a bogeyman
that has undergone
some kind of
transformation. If
you stand dumbfounded
by its almost comical
appearance, it will
attack in a flash and
leave you unable to move.

Its eerie coloration gives it something
of the appearance of a grim reaper.

translations.en:
A crow whose constitution
is said to have been
changed by the mist drifting
through the city. Its cry
alone is so hideous that
it raises goose bumps.

Perhaps because it feeds on
the corpses of adventurers
and monsters, it is said to
reek constantly of death, with
blood dripping from its beak.

translations.en:
A monster with a
jet-black body and faintly
gleaming fur that exudes
a truly strange aura.

Let that mysterious presence
overwhelm you, and its powerful
arms will beat you down. By
the time you realize what has
happened, you will be lying flat
on your back, staring at the sky.

translations.en:
Orcs are called simpleminded,
but this is said to be
a form that has gained
leadership skills and
strengthened itself. Its
body is superbly trained
and amply powerful. Yet it
does not place excessive
faith in its own strength,
instead seeking to coordinate
with its companions. In
light of that, we must
retract the claim that
it is simpleminded.

translations.en:
A ghoul variant with patches
of its body transformed
into steel. Whether this
occurred naturally or it
deliberately turned its own
body to steel is unknown.
Whatever the cause, its
attack and defense are now
beyond comparison with their
former levels. Steel might
suggest a slow, lumbering
creature, but anyone who
clings to that impression
will certainly regret it.

translations.en:
An alligator variant with hard,
black scales. Records tell
of large numbers hunted in
the past for their beautiful
hides, which were used in
ornaments and other items.

Those that survived
apparently persist to
this day. Perhaps that is
why they are so ferocious
that even approaching
them is difficult.

translations.en:
A dragon encountered
so rarely that even its
existence seems hazy. Those
who fight it reportedly
feel that victory is
impossible. This is not
because the dragon is too
powerful, but because they
sense it simply "cannot
be defeated." Even after
successfully killing one,
no body remains. Many are
left wondering whether they
truly defeated it at all.

translations.en:
A bear said to have
protected a mountain god
long ago. That god is now
gone, and these once-sacred
guardians have fallen to
the level of mere monsters.

They still live up to the name
of guardian. Underestimate
one as an ordinary bear and
its powerful body and sharp
claws will make an offering
of you in an instant.

translations.en:
A being said to have
come from another world.
No monster researcher
could explain why it
came to this one.

Gather what little information
exists, and all you hear
is, "If you encounter one,
run." This is hardly useful.

Seeking the truth about these
beings may be equivalent to seeking
the truth of the universe itself.

translations.en:
A wererat variant
that moves in units
like an army. It
never breaks formation
or does anything so
foolish as act alone.

It is still a monster,
however. Threaten its
survival and you can break
its ranks. Only those who
let down their guard will
end up on its dinner table.

translations.en:
A giant said to have
been born from mud.

When injured, it immediately
obtains more of the mud that
forms its body from earth and
stones at its feet, repairing
itself. Its claylike arms are
also terribly heavy and hard.

And it smells appalling.
It is thought to
ferment the prey
trapped inside its body.

translations.en:
Said to be a wandering soul
transformed into a monster.

Its name comes from its
existence being reversed
compared with an ordinary
spirit. Yet when a
soul itself is only a
conceptual thing, does
it really matter whether
it is reversed or not?

The only thing we know for
certain is that it is extremely
resistant to physical attacks.

translations.en:
A monster bearing the name of courage.

Its courage repels spells,
and the swordplay unleashed
by its gleaming blade
must not be taken lightly.

Or so one report claims.
The author was probably
drunk. There is no
harm in treating it as
simply a strong kobold.

translations.en:
A warrior who has devoted himself
solely to perfecting his swordplay.
His techniques are beautiful
enough to captivate anyone who
sees them. The fate of someone
who stops to admire them in battle
hardly needs to be written down.

His sword glows eerily.
One adventurer who saw his
techniques even wondered
whether the sword was
controlling the man.

translations.en:
The flame in its hand is
often said to be someone's
soul. It seems to fuel
its magic with souls. At
the instant a spell is
cast, the flame in its
hand flickers eerily.

It is even thought to
collect souls in order
to sustain that power.

translations.en:
Said to be a former Kensei
who strayed from the path.

Why it continues wandering the
labyrinth is unknown. Its mind
is terribly warped, and it has
forgotten its humanity, doing
nothing more than existing.

Some speculate that
witnessing an even greater
power drove it mad.

translations.en:
A were-elephant variant
burning with fighting spirit
that finds meaning in its
existence through battle.

Protecting something is normally
its purpose. Perhaps some power has
driven it astray, but the strength
unleashed from its restraints
inspires even a sense of awe.

translations.en:
Small in stature, but thought
to be a Peluda variant.
It is said to make a meal
of the very people who,
captivated by its dazzling
colors, try to capture it.

Small though it may be, it is still
classified as an ancient dragon,
and remains just as dangerous.

translations.en:
A dark angel, or demon, whose
bewitching eyes were said to
steal a human soul in an instant,
and whose single smile could
destroy a kingdom. Its true
power should be sealed, yet
it remains immensely powerful.
If that power returns, the
continent of Azarus is said to
be doomed to obliteration within
seven days. This dark angel
once ruled the world alongside
angels of light. Since falling
from grace, however, it seems
to exist only to bring harm.
